noel: Quick heads-up — raven int4 canary shows ~2.6% 'bounce' where adapter logs two tool_start events for same semantic call.
maya: Mirror confirms: two emits, different transient ids, usually one return consumed.
noel: Sanitized example: ```recv seq=0 {"fn":"addr","args":{"q":"X"}} retry tmp=t1 recv seq=1 {"fn":"addr","args":{"q":"X"}}```
ravi: Likely runtime retry + streaming reassembly. Short-term: adapter compute semantic fingerprint (sorted keys, normalize whitespace/escapes, strip trailing commas) + hash; dedupe within 5s window.
noel: Risk: suppressing legitimate retries with changed args. Mitigate with arg-diff threshold and emit suppressed_retry metric.
maya: I'll wire mirror harness to sample 20k sessions and store ~100 raw+repaired artifacts for tuning.
ravi: Ill send CL + unit tests (edge escapes, trailing commas, unicode NFC).
ops-bot: @noel Deployment requested: raven-int4-canary flag=fp_dedupe=true scope=1% queued.
noel: Post first numbers after 200k mirrored requests. Abort if latency or error rate spikes.
